Lady '''Serailla''' is Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] of [[Kandor]]'s First Councilor. 

== Appearance ==
She is round with a placid face and has dark eyes.

She could have been a farm-wife suddenly stuck into a noblewoman’s riding dress, but the mind behind those plain, sweaty features was as sharp as any [[Aes Sedai]]’s. 

Stout yet as graceful in her saddle as she is at dancing, Serailla is always smooth. Not oily, or false; just completely unflappable. 

== Activities ==
She accompanies Ethenielle to the meeting with the other Borderland Rulers.
